name: Patro
author: Anish Gupta
description: Nepali calendar for the Omarchy bar. Bikram Sambat date, month view, tithi, and year progress.

barWidget.description: Today's Bikram Sambat date in the bar, with a Nepali month view, the tithi, and dual BS/AD calendar view with year progress.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Nepali writes month, weekday and tithi names in Devanagari. English romanises them.

schema.label: Numerals
schema.description: Whether Bikram Sambat dates read २०८३ or 2083. Gregorian dates always use Latin digits.

schema.label: Bar format
schema.description: Right-clicking the bar label walks these in order.

schema.label: Show weekday
schema.description: Put the weekday in front of the date in the bar.

schema.label: Week starts on
schema.description: Nepali calendars start the week on Sunday and treat Saturday as the holiday.

schema.label: Show Gregorian dates
schema.description: Print the Gregorian day under each day of the month view.

schema.label: Show tithi
schema.description: Show the lunar day, and mark Ekadashi, Purnima and Aunsi in the month view.

schema.label: Font family
schema.description: Leave empty to inherit the bar font. Devanagari needs a font that covers it, such as Noto Sans Devanagari.
